subject: general
question: A room with a square base and height 10 ft occupies 25,000 ft³ volume. The room has cubicles of base area 25 ft² in four corners. The walls and ceiling of the area of the room which is not occupied by cubicles is to be painted. How much area is to be painted?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Volume = base area × height ⇒ Base = 25000 ÷ 10 = 2500 ft² ⇒ side = 50 ft

Wall area = perimeter × height = (4 × 50) × 10 = 2000 ft²

Cubicles: each side = 5 ⇒ blocked per wall = 5 + 5 = 10 ⇒ effective wall = 50 − 10 = 40

New wall area = 4 × 40 × 10 = 1600 ft²; Ceiling left = 2500 − (4 × 25) = 2400 ft²

Total area = 1600 + 2400 = 4000 ft²

**∴ Answer = 4000 ft²**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Volume = 25000 ft³, Height = 10 ft, Cubicle base = 25 ft² each (4 cubicles)

**Formula used:**

Volume = side² × height; Wall area = perimeter × height

 50 ft 50 ft Room 

Base area = 25000 ÷ 10 = 2500 ft²

Side = √2500 = 50 ft

Each cubicle side = √25 = 5 ft

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total wall area = 4 × 50 × 10 = 2000 ft²

⇒ Blocked wall per side = 5 + 5 = 10 ft

⇒ Effective wall per side = 40 ft

⇒ Wall area to paint = 4 × 40 × 10 = 1600 ft²

⇒ Ceiling area = 2500 − (4 × 25) = 2400 ft²

⇒ Total painted area = 1600 + 2400 = 4000 ft²

**∴ The correct answer is 4000 ft².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Area Deduction

Subtract cubicle occupied areas from total before painting
